title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Heimdall to the tools you already use: GitHub, Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty, email and other analysis tools.

ci.heading: Check every pull request automatically
ci.intro: Adds a GitHub workflow that tests your agent on every pull request and comments whether it got better or worse.
ci.modeRecorded: Use saved results (re-check a finished comparison, no worker needed)
ci.modeLive: Run fresh (old vs new agent, on your own worker)
ci.installInSettings: GitHub is connected. Pick the repository, branch and how to check in Settings > GitHub to open the setup pull request.
ci.manual: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server. Copy the workflow below into .github/workflows/heimdall.yml in your repository by hand.
ci.notConnected: Connect GitHub in Settings > GitHub to open the setup pull request from there. Until then you can copy the workflow below into your repository by hand.

exports.heading: Download results for other tools
exports.intro: Makes a file you can open in other tools. It is prepared in the background and appears below when ready.

formats.otlp: Step-by-step traces for tracing tools (Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, Jaeger, any OpenTelemetry tool)
formats.eee: Every Eval Ever records (shared results format)
formats.harbor: Harbor task folders (benchmark tasks, hidden checks left out)

exports.payloads: Include what the agent sent to and got back from its tools (private values hidden, size limited)
exports.noExperiments: No comparison yet. Run one first, then download it here.
exports.empty: No files yet. Pick a format and a comparison above, then press Make file.
exports.name: File

webhooks.heading: Send results and alerts to your tools
webhooks.intro: Heimdall posts to Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty or any web address when an evaluation finishes, an agent gets worse, a release is blocked, a scheduled check fails or a worker goes offline. Failed deliveries are retried for 24 hours.
webhooks.hostedNote: This server delivers only to public https URLs.
webhooks.secretOnce: Secret for checking messages are really from Heimdall. Shown once, store it now:
webhooks.empty: Nothing set up yet. Add Slack, Teams, PagerDuty or a web address to hear when an evaluation finishes or an agent gets worse.
webhooks.signing: Verify X-Heimdall-Signature: sha256 HMAC of "<X-Heimdall-Timestamp>.<body>" with the webhook's secret.

urlLabels.pagerduty: Events API address (leave empty for events.pagerduty.com)

formatHelp.json: Each message is the event as JSON, signed with the secret shown once below.
formatHelp.slack: In Slack, add the Incoming Webhooks app to a channel and paste its URL. Messages show the score, the change and a button to the report card.
formatHelp.teams: In Teams, add the Workflows app "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" and paste its URL. Messages are cards with the score and the change.
formatHelp.pagerduty: In PagerDuty, add an Events API v2 integration to a service and paste its integration key. Only problems page: regressions, blocked releases, failed checks, offline workers. Send test checks the key without opening an incident.

errors.load: Could not load this section. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, check that the server is running.
errors.adminOnly: Changing notifications needs the admin role. Ask an admin of your organization.

webhooks.desc: Slack, Teams, PagerDuty, email and web addresses.

deliveryLog.heading: Delivery log
deliveryLog.intro: Every webhook delivery, newest first. Failed deliveries are tried again with growing waits for up to 24 hours.
deliveryLog.empty: No deliveries yet. They appear here when an event fires.

email.heading: Email me
email.intro: Your own choice: what reaches {{email}} by email. Other members choose for themselves.
email.digest: Weekly digest every Monday: your agents, their scores, what changed and what it cost
email.testLogged: Test email written to the server log for {{to}}: this server has no mail service yet
email.notDelivering: This server has no mail service set up yet, so emails are only written to its log. Ask your server owner to set HEIMDALL_SMTP_URL, or a Resend or Postmark key.
email.unavailable: Email notifications are not available here: {{reason}}.
